description: This file defines core types, constants, and functions for handling CBOR data encoding/decoding, including type definitions, tag handling, and utility functions.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string for the cborType.

methods.name: isIndefiniteLength
methods.description: Checks if the additionalInformation value indicates an indefinite length.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Extracts the major type from a raw byte.

methods.name: getAdditionalInformation
methods.description: Extracts the additional information from a raw byte.

methods.name: isBreakFlag
methods.description: Checks if a byte is the CBOR break flag.

methods.name: parseInitialByte
methods.description: Parses the initial byte into type and additional information.
